game_title: Strip And Replace – Rockfall Chute Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Rockfall Chute, a rockfall chute: the rescue climber must handle snow leopards while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Strip And Replace: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it.
theme: Frost Peaks – Rockfall Chute: a rockfall chute
core_gameplay_loop: In Rockfall Chute, repeat each round: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the clean_text value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about clean_text to power up the rescue climber and open the cliff anchor.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 3 (intro tier): Strip And Replace
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
